description: This file defines a Feign client interface for communication with a core banking service API, including methods for reading account information and performing utility payments.

classes.name: BankingCoreRestClient
classes.description: Interface defining REST API methods for core banking operations such as account retrieval and utility payment processing.

methods.name: readAccount
methods.description: Fetches account details from the core banking service based on the provided account number.

methods.name: utilityPayment
methods.description: Initiates a utility payment request through the core banking service.
